sources.summary: The cavernous earth chambers of an anthill informed the stack of curved brick balconies that front this home in Maharashtra, India, designed by local studio Kaushal Tatiya Architects. Aptly named The Anthill, the 650-square-metre home in Ahilyanagar is designed to offer cool living spaces in the region's hot, dry climate without mechanical ventilation.
